title: Banking App support engineer
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

Application Support engineer to provide L1/L2 24/7 banking and payments application support experience in banking domain, analyze, debug & resolve production issues. Strong Experience with SQL, Linux, Oracle, IIS, Devops, API, troubleshooting, application monitoring, log checking, Incident management & resolution, fine tuning, root cause analysis, scripting and automation skills

Your future at Kyndryl
  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscale's that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise** :

* 5 to 10 years experience in providing L1/L2 application support for payment systems UPI, NEFT/RTGS, ATM, DCMS, 42CS, Getepay and Fraud risk management applications
* Should have a very good understanding of Recon, batch processes, Core banking systems etc
* Should have knowledge on s like Flexcube Retail (FCR) India banking system, Onboarding Systems, Lending, Internet Banking, Mobile Banking, Payments, CRM etc
* Should have good exposure to customer onboarding process, KYC, API integration, workflows etc
* Should be able to write complex SQL queries, mapping tables from source to target systems
* Knowledge in banking domain, especially for India specific requirements.
* Strong technical acumen & deep working knowledge of Agile Methods, Service Architecture and Integration
* Strong ability to influence, collaborate and build relationships with key stakeholders, vendors, and cross-functional teams
* **Job location:** Thrissur/Cochin/Kerala

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

* Software Engineering Life Cycle deliverables for banking projects
* Work closely with the business and IT teams to analyse business requirements, analyse and resolve production issues, root cause analysis, identify automation scope etc
* SQL, Linux, Oracle, IIS, Devops, API, troubleshooting, application monitoring, log checking, Incident management & resolution
* Experience in using and implementing DevSecOps processes

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: AWS Glue Developer
description:

**Job Summary**

Technical Lead role in a global organization focusing on advanced bioinformatics solutions powered by AWS services and Python. The position involves designing and delivering scalable data pipelines analytical workflows and applications to support scientific research and healthcare innovations. The role is hybrid with day shift targeting experienced professionals who can bridge cloud engineering and bioinformatics expertise to create impactful outcomes for society.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and implement scalable cloud based data pipelines on AWS that efficiently process complex bioinformatics datasets to support research and clinical decision workflows
* Develop robust Python applications and scripts that enable advanced sequence analysis and data transformation while ensuring code quality and maintainability
* Optimize storage and retrieval of genomic and proteomic data using AWS services to deliver reliable performance for data intensive experiments
* Collaborate with cross functional scientific and engineering teams to translate bioinformatics requirements into precise technical designs and implementation plans
* Guide end to end solution architecture for hybrid work environments ensuring secure access to AWS resources and seamless integration with on premise data systems
* Ensure adherence to best practices for security compliance and governance across AWS environments to protect sensitive biomedical and health related information

* Coordinate day to day task planning and technical guidance for team members focusing on high impact features that advance company research and product goals
* Document system designs data models and workflow specifications in a clear manner so that scientific stakeholders and engineers share a common understanding
* Engage in continuous improvement of existing Python codebases and AWS configurations by refactoring components and adopting modern tooling and automation
* Support validation and quality assurance activities for bioinformatics analyses by implementing reproducible pipelines and thorough logging within AWS environments
* Communicate progress risks and technical decisions to stakeholders using concise updates that emphasize outcomes for patient care and scientific discovery
* Contribute to innovation initiatives by exploring new AWS capabilities and Python libraries that can enhance bioinformatics insights and societal impact

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate strong hands on experience with core AWS services such as compute storage networking and data platform components applied to complex analytical workloads
* Show advanced proficiency with Python including data processing libraries testing frameworks and packaging practices relevant to bioinformatics pipelines
* Exhibit practical experience in bioinformatics including handling high throughput sequencing data annotation workflows and biological database integration
* Understand hybrid work models and day shift collaboration patterns and apply effective communication and coordination techniques for distributed technical teams
* Apply sound software engineering practices including version control continuous integration automated testing and documentation in production bioinformatics systems
* Display familiarity with cloud cost optimization techniques and performance tuning strategies to ensure efficient use of AWS resources in research environments
* Utilize knowledge of data privacy and regulatory expectations in biomedical contexts to design solutions that safeguard sensitive information and maintain trust

**Certifications Required**

**Job Listing Detail:**

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**EY- Cyber Security – Infrastructure Security – Manager**

As part of our EY Cyber Security team, you will manage infrastructure security engagements and support the design, integration and implementation of solutions that enhance service delivery and enable technology-driven transformation for our clients. You will coordinate delivery teams, manage engagement activities, maintain quality standards, and coach junior team members to support their professional development.

  

**The opportunity**

We’re looking for an Infrastructure Security professional with a solution-oriented mindset, strong security engineering knowledge, and experience managing network security architecture and implementation engagements. The role requires the ability to translate client requirements into practical solutions, coordinate technical delivery, manage risks and stakeholders, and contribute to the rollout of next-generation, market-relevant security services.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Manage the design, architecture, assessment and implementation of network security solutions across on-premises and cloud environments.
* Gather business and technical requirements, develop solution approaches, and oversee preparation and review of high-level and low-level design documentation.
* Lead workstreams covering next-generation firewalls, IPS/IDS, VPN, NAC, SD-WAN, DDoS protection, wireless security, WAF, secure web gateways and proxy solutions.
* Provide technical oversight for solutions involving Palo Alto Networks, Check Point, Fortinet, Zscaler and comparable infrastructure security technologies.
* Manage solution deployment, configuration, integration, testing, transition and operational-readiness activities in accordance with agreed scope and quality expectations.
* Support Zero Trust architecture and implementation initiatives, including segmentation and micro-segmentation solutions such as Guardicore and Illumio.
* Review network and platform security designs to confirm alignment with security principles, client standards, regulatory obligations and leading practices.
* Manage engagement plans, delivery milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, budgets and status reporting, escalating material concerns when required.
* Coordinate with client stakeholders, architects, engineers, vendors and other delivery teams to resolve technical and operational challenges.
* Review network drawings, configuration standards, implementation procedures, test evidence and operational documentation for completeness and quality.
* Contribute to proposals, statements of work, solution demonstrations, effort estimates and other business-development activities.
* Coach team members, allocate work, review deliverables and promote consistent use of delivery methodologies, reusable assets and automation.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

* Strong technical knowledge of infrastructure and network security architecture, engineering and operations.
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams and deliver high-quality outcomes within agreed scope, schedule and budget.
* Sound understanding of infrastructure security services, governance models, operating models, controls and delivery methodologies.
* Ability to build trusted relationships with client managers, technical leads, vendors and internal stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, presentation and decision-making skills.
* Ability to communicate technical risks, architecture decisions and delivery concerns clearly to technical and business stakeholders.
* Experience supervising technical teams, reviewing deliverables, providing constructive feedback and supporting capability development.
* Commercial awareness and the ability to support scoping, effort estimation, resource planning and engagement financial management.
* A proactive, adaptable and collaborative approach in a fast-paced consulting environment.
* Ability to create and deliver domain-specific training and knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Understanding of automation opportunities that improve security operations, service quality and delivery efficiency.
* Willingness to travel and work flexibly when required by client or engagement needs.

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 12+ years of Information Technology experience, including significant experience in infrastructure or network security and at least 5 years leading technical workstreams or small delivery teams.
* Strong experience in security engineering, architecture assessments, solution design and implementation.
* Hands-on knowledge of firewalls, VPN, NAC, SD-WAN, WAF, proxy, IPS/IDS, DDoS protection, EDR/XDR and related controls.
* Experience deploying, maintaining or operating one or more enterprise network security platforms.
* Working knowledge of Zero Trust principles, segmentation, micro-segmentation and secure access architectures.
* Understanding of cloud security architecture and hybrid infrastructure security considerations.
* Demonstrated experience managing client expectations, project risks, delivery quality and technical documentation.
* A consultative and pragmatic approach to solving security and technology challenges.

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Excellent verbal and written communication, technical documentation and stakeholder-management skills.
* Strong project management, negotiation, team leadership and interpersonal capabilities.
* Prior experience in advisory, professional services, system integration or technology consulting.
* Customer-focused mindset with experience contributing to proposals, estimations and solution presentations.
* Relevant professional certification such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, SABSA, TOGAF, PRINCE2 or a leading vendor security certification.

  

**What we look for**

* A manager with strong technical credibility, commercial awareness and the ability to lead teams in a fast-moving consulting environment.
* A collaborative professional who can work effectively with multidisciplinary teams and global EY Consulting practices across industries.
* A delivery-focused individual who takes ownership of engagement outcomes, quality, team performance and client satisfaction.
* Someone able to contribute to go-to-market activities, RFP responses, solution development and effort estimation.
* A confident facilitator who can lead cyber security discussions with subject-matter experts, client managers, senior stakeholders and enterprise architects.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
